title: Making and Answering Phone Calls
summary: Learn how to say hello, ask for someone, and end a phone call in English. These easy phrases help you talk on the phone with confidence.

sections.p: When the phone rings, you need to say hello and tell the other person who is speaking. Keep it short and friendly. At work, you can also say your company name. When speaking to friends, you can use more casual words.

ex.mean: Saying hello and giving your name
A friendly way to say who is calling

sections.p: If you want to talk to a specific person, you must ask for them politely. We use modal verbs like 'can' or 'could' to sound polite. You can also ask to leave a message if the person is not there.

ex.en: Can I speak to Mr. Davis, please?
ex.mean: Politely asking to talk to someone
A simpler way to ask for a friend
Asking the person to tell them something later

sections.p: When you finish talking, you should say goodbye politely. It is nice to thank the other person for their time or help before you hang up. Then you can say goodbye.

ex.en: Thank you for your help. Goodbye!
ex.mean: Saying thank you and ending the call
A friendly way to end a chat with a friend

tip: Practice speaking out loud into your phone in front of a mirror. Imagine you are talking to a real person to feel more relaxed.
